bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us The focus of our research is in two major areas: the treatment of patients with solid tumors -- notably neuroblastoma -- and the study of survivors of childhood cancer. In treating patients with neuroblastoma, our approach has been to intensify therapy using high-dose therapy in tandem with stem cell rescue. We are participants in the NANT (New Agents in Neuroblastoma Therapy) consortium and the COG Phase 1 consortium.
research_interests: we have been studying young adult patients with a history of cancer treatment
000 survivors. We have completed an analysis of breast cancers in that cohort
and we are studying risk factors for secondary sarcomas.
